title: Online resharding
objection: You cannot grow a sharded keyspace without a flush.

claims.detail: shard count is a power of two so that growth is a split, not a reshuffle

claims.claim: split 32 -> 64 shards moved 11,071 of 20,000 records in 10095 ms
claims.detail: about half the keys move, which is the whole point of powers of two. 97,399 reads and 43,149 writes ran concurrently.

claims.claim: no read missed during the split: 0 of 97,399
claims.detail: readers check the new home then the pre-split home, so a record in either is found

claims.claim: all 20,000 records readable after the split (0 missing, 0 corrupted)
claims.detail: checked one by one against the id that was written

claims.claim: 20,000 stored fields for 20,000 records: no duplicates left behind
claims.detail: a copy left in the old home would show up here as an extra field

claims.claim: generation went unset -> 6, draining flag cleared
claims.detail: while draining, the marker carries the previous k so readers know to check both homes
